Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. In the very first step, the search results explicitly identified "Steven the Sword Fighter" as the 16th episode of the first season of *Steven Universe* and included a snippet stating it "first aired on 9 April 2014". Furthermore, the results mentioned the series had concluded (with *Steven Universe Future* ending in March 2020). Despite this clear evidence that the series was finished and the specific episode date was available, the WebSurfer agent did not extract or report this information. Instead, it incorrectly concluded that there was no definitive next episode date and proceeded to make redundant, circular searches without ever synthesizing the fact that the show was over or providing the historical air date of the episode in question. This failure to process the available data led to the incorrect final answer of "TBD".
